description:
SuperQDA connects your qualitative research workspace to ChatGPT. Access your research projects, documents, codes, and analyses directly in conversation.

What you can do:
- Browse and read all your uploaded documents (PDFs, Word files, transcripts)
- Perform semantic search across your research data using perform_semantic_search
- Create and apply qualitative codes to text segments using create_code and create_coded_segment
- Write analytical memos and save structured analyses
- Search for keywords across all project documents with perform_text_search

SuperQDA is a qualitative data analysis (QDA) platform used by researchers, academics, and students for thematic analysis, grounded theory, and other qualitative methodologies. This integration lets you leverage ChatGPT's reasoning capabilities directly on your research data without leaving the conversation.

All data access is secured with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE. Your credentials are never shared with ChatGPT.
